CustomField.description: Calculates how many days a case has been opened
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK( Reopened_Date__c ) , IF( ISBLANK( ClosedDate ) , Today() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate), DATEVALUE(ClosedDate) - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) , Today() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) )
CustomField.label: Case Open Time (Days)
